newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices edge lower, volume falls.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices edge lower, volume falls.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume dropped to 475 kg on Thursday from Wednesday's 830 kg amid uncertainty over the markets' direction, dealers said.
Gold prices edged slightly lower to $352.80 an ounce and 1,422,000 lira per gramme, compared to $353.30 and 1,422,500 lira on Wednesday.
"There was quite a lot of buyer activity in the morning session, but in the second session dealers were sidelined amid uncertainty over the direction of the market," one dealer said.
There was 450 kg traded in the morning session, with only 25 kg changing hands in the afternoon. Of the day's trade, 94.7 percent of trade was conducted in lira terms.
